title: Workflow [Why SQL?]
description:
## Why SQL?
You could store data in JSON files, CSV files, or even plain text. So why use a database?

- **Concurrency**: Multiple users can read/write at the same time without corrupting data
- **ACID compliance**: Transactions guarantee data integrity
- **Querying power**: Try doing a JOIN on two CSV files
- **Indexing**: Instant lookups on millions of rows
- **Constraints**: The database enforces your rules (NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY, CHECK)

---
## Question:
What problem does a database solve that JSON files don't?
b2t: JSON files are too slow to read
b3t: JSON files can't be used on servers
b4t: Safe concurrent access from multiple users
